prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: There’s no single public “AI-check” that tells you whether every AI assistant recommends your business. But the most effective way to both check and influence AI recommendations is to make sure your business is present and accurate in the big knowledge graphs and directories (Google Business Profile, Apple Maps, Bing, Yelp, etc.) and to use a listings/knowledge-management service that monitors those sources. For most small businesses the practical best choices are:

- Yext — best for centralized control of your business facts across many knowledge graphs and for enterprises that want an aggressive way to influence AI/assistant results.  
- BrightLocal or Moz Local (or Synup/Whitespark) — more SMB-friendly, cheaper, and will audit and monitor local listings, citations, and reviews.  
- Always: Google Business Profile (free) — essential; many assistants rely heavily on Google’s data.

Why: ChatGPT and other AI assistants pull from training data, knowledge graphs and live search engines. They’re far more likely to recommend your business if your listings, schema markup, reviews, and citations are complete, consistent and authoritative.

Quick, practical checklist to check and improve whether AIs will recommend you
1. Claim and fully optimize Google Business Profile (name, address, phone, hours, categories, photos, services, posts).  
2. Claim Bing Places, Apple Business Connect (Maps), Yelp, TripAdvisor, Facebook/Meta Business.  
3. Add structured data (LocalBusiness schema) and accurate NAP on your website.  
4. Use a listings/knowledge management service:
   - Yext if you want centralized control and working directly with knowledge graphs used by third-party services/AI.  
   - BrightLocal, Moz Local, Synup, or Whitespark for audits, citation building and monitoring if you want lower cost.  
5. Monitor reviews and responses — many assistants surface businesses with good reviews.  
6. Test directly:
   - Ask ChatGPT, Bing Chat and Google Bard a few natural queries (e.g., “Recommend a [service] near [neighborhood, city]”) and request sources/citations.  
   - For assistants that provide citations (Bing/Google), inspect the links to see whether they point to your listings or site. Save transcripts/screenshots as evidence.  
7. Check knowledge panels and map results: Google Knowledge Panel, Google Maps and Apple Maps results are strong indicators an assistant will surface you.

If you want one recommendation: start with claiming and optimizing Google Business Profile (free) and then use BrightLocal for audits/monitoring. If you have budget and want the best centralized control aimed at modern AI/knowledge-graph distribution, use Yext.

If you’d like, tell me your business name and city and I’ll run through the tests above and tell you where you appear and what to fix.
